A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 12-page paper, Riemannian-Geometric Fingerprints of Generative Models, including Appendix A. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish matching scientific material, with differences confined to the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its link.

before.justification: Sections 4.2–4.4 and Tables 3–4 report original attribution accuracies, fingerprint-separability measurements, and cross-dataset generalization results for the proposed methods.

after.justification: Sections 4.2–4.4 and Tables 3–4 retain the work's original attribution, fingerprint-separability, and cross-dataset generalization results.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–4 and Section 3.3 are identical, retaining the VAE-based pullback metric, Riemannian center-of-mass estimation, artifact computation, and ResNet50 attribution classifier.

E1.justification: Both retain GM-CIFAR10, GM-CelebA, GM-CHQ, and GM-FFHQ, the same text-to-image model extension documented in Appendix A, and the same attribution and cross-dataset evaluation scenarios.

E2.justification: Tables 3–4 retain the same 11 comparator rows, including both Marra methods and the RGB and frequency variants of ManiFPT. No comparator is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: The 7:2:1 training/validation/test split, accuracy and FDR metrics, sample counts, model configurations, and cross-dataset testing procedures are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendix A.

E4.justification: Sections 4.2–4.4 retain the same Euclidean-versus-geodesic variant comparison, feature-separability analysis, and cross-dataset generalization tests. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Tables 3–4 retain identical ± reporting. No run-count, seed, significance-testing, or uncertainty-estimation documentation changes.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 3–4 and the reported qualitative findings are identical. For example, R-GMfpts_RCM retains 78.17 ± 0.53% accuracy on GM-CIFAR10 in Table 3.

T1.justification: Definitions 2.1 and 3.1–3.3, Equations 1–12, and the accompanying manifold and sample-sparsity assumptions are unchanged. No mathematical reasoning or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about the Riemannian fingerprint definition, practical estimation algorithm, benchmark extension, and improved attribution and generalization.

C2.justification: The explanations linking geodesic center-of-mass estimation to better manifold projections and cross-dataset results to practical generalizability are identical. No applicability boundary or limitation is added or revised.

D1.justification: The VAE and classifier implementation descriptions are unchanged. Appendix A retains identical prompts, pretrained-model sources, default sampling instructions, and image counts; no code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: All 70 references and the discussion positioning the work as a Riemannian generalization of ManiFPT are unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1, dated 28 Jun 2025, to v2, dated 28 Oct 2025. The prose, terminology, headings, and section and appendix organization are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–3, Tables 1–4, algorithm displays, captions, and their placement are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–12 are identical; page 1 differs only in the version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, empirical evidence, technical documentation, and Appendix A are identical. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its link does not change the paper's clarity, reproducibility, or evidential support.
